scope: Preserve scarce scanner evaluation slots for current opportunities without false admissions, unevaluated-signal dedup bans, equal-priority starvation, stale occupancy or invalid numeric priority. Keep every trading gate, exact0.1 SOL PAPER, uncapped runner exits and operator runtime OFF.

findings.evidence: Actual HotQueue.add returned true when the incoming candidate was immediately evicted. Both a never-evaluated candidate and a changed signal previously queued after an earlier evaluation were rejected on reentry after capacity freed, before the1800-second TTL. Three isolated original tests failed.
findings.repair: Return whether the new version actually remains pending. Restore only the last signal/time delivered for evaluation after an overflow or expiry. Clear false admission history when nothing was delivered. Record evaluation TTL at the actual pop, rather than an older enqueue clock.

findings.evidence: An equal-priority third candidate displaced the first waiting candidate at capacity two; the original FIFO overflow test failed.
findings.repair: At equal score, evict the newest queued version rather than a version already waiting. Normal highest-priority pop order and configured capacity remain unchanged.

findings.evidence: An update from rank_score50 to90 was rejected as unchanged when price/volume/route bins did not move; the original pending-update test failed.
findings.repair: Bind the normalized current explicit rank to the dedup signal, including its documented fallback alias. Both pending updates and bounded later reconsideration can use a changed rank. An unchanged evaluated signal still observes TTL, and changed evaluated signals still observe the recheck interval.

findings.evidence: A null age field refreshed the observation clock of an older inherited valid age. Separately, an expired high-priority candidate evicted a fresh lower-priority candidate before expiry was checked; both original tests failed.
findings.repair: Only a valid finite nonnegative non-boolean incoming age refreshes its observation clock. Preserve the original clock on partial invalid updates. Apply the same existing configured age rule before admitting expired candidates, before capacity competition and at actual pop.

findings.evidence: Code inspection showed float(true) could become rank100 and a complete learned market snapshot, while rank_score0 could fall through to a higher research_rank_score alias. New isolated guards verify unknown invalid JSON numeric inputs and measured zero.
findings.repair: Reject JSON boolean measurements for numeric priority and for the four required learned-market inputs. Preserve an explicit measured zero before the nullable alias fallback; no probability or buying permission is inferred.

operational_contract.grain: One case-sensitive mint with one pending version and its last delivered market signal. Pop is handoff to the evaluator, not proof that entry admission completed or that any trade occurred.
operational_contract.sources: The actual main-loop PumpFun ingestion calls GLOBAL_HOT_QUEUE.add and the incremental scheduler pops just in time before the common guarded entry path. The queue patch does not change that execution path or add provider requests.
operational_contract.limits: Existing capacity, dynamic/just-in-time batch behavior, recheck interval, evaluated-signal TTL, birth/age bounds and trading gates remain. No stale candidate or rank score grants buy permission. Histories and heap versions retain bounded cleanup, and telemetry stays local unless the existing persist_events option is enabled.
operational_contract.model_scope: This handles explicit rank updates carried by the source snapshot; it does not establish joint cross-family strategy approval, automatic repricing of every queued candidate on artifact replacement or optimal trade selection.
operational_contract.financial_limit: Synthetic queue repair does not prove that a real profitable token was previously lost, that future winning tokens will be captured or that all providers/depth/latency are available. No operational model, policy, journal, price history or wallet is changed.
